title: Lemon Studio Michael Lane Edition 2026.11.04.1
notes:
- Lemon Wave adds a playable six-octave keyboard, scale-aware chords and a tempo-synced arpeggiator for both mouse and MIDI input.
- Explore Lemon Wave's Night Shift factory bank, save and browse categorized user presets, and build and audition wavetables from marked recordings.
- Drag the Lemon Sampler waveform to the Browser to save a new edited WAV in Favorites. The Browser can also detach into a movable, resizable window. Right Arrow replays the highlighted sample, and Shift+Up/Down sends samples to the selected sampler channel.
- In the Piano Roll, Ctrl+right-click fits the notes, middle-dragging the preview keyboard adjusts lane height, and scrolling over the labelled snap control changes grid resolution.
- Song mode can run across an empty Playlist. Click BPM to type a tempo, or drag to adjust it. Press D in a channel's context menu to delete that channel with undo.
- The main toolbar shrinks and wraps when the window narrows, keeping navigation visible. The Channel Rack has a step-pattern icon and the compact hint field sits on the right.
- On macOS, Waves channel strips in the mixer scale proportionally with the mixer height, with pointer controls mapped to the displayed editor.
